parameters.query: INSERT INTO ask_usage (member_id, day, questions) VALUES (coalesce(bgc.member_id($1), 0), current_date, 1) ON CONFLICT (member_id, day) DO UPDATE SET questions = ask_usage.questions + 1 RETURNING questions
